title: Levuvo SF own dependencies (A4, GA4.5-GA4.7)
description: docs/DEPENDENCIES.json. Only own dependencies (other factory projects, mirrored GitHub repos); third-party packages stay in the stack's normal manifest. Packages are identified by Package URL (purl) with an exact version.

purl.description: Package URL (ECMA-427) with an exact version, e.g. pkg:npm/%40levuvo/ui@1.2.0. The factory parses it with a standards-compliant purl parser and checks the version against SemVer 2.0.0 without ranges (GA4.5).

repository.description: Source repo on the local git server (mirror for GitHub repos).

source_project.description: Factory project id, if the dependency is another factory project.

integration.description: Currently the only supported path: SemVer package from the Forgejo registry via the normal package manager. Another path needs a new ADR and a new schema version.
